The PowerLogic ADVC Controller implements version 5 of the secure authentication feature as specified in the IEEE standard document 1815-2012.
heading: DNP3 Security

text: DNP3 Secure Authentication functionality for the PowerLogic ADVC Controller can only be enabled and configured through WSOS.
heading: DNP3 Security

text: DNP3 and DNP3 Security must firstly be made available through Feature Selection in WSOS.
heading: DNP3 Security

text: Once DNP3 Security has been made available, Secure Authentication can be configured through WSOS by going to:
heading: Secure Authentication

text: Display> Switchgear Communications > Protocols > DNP3 > DNP3 Secure Authentication.
heading: Secure Authentication

text: This page allows the configuration of operational parameters for DNP3 Secure Authentication, along with Update Keys (secret keys shared between the master station and outstation) for up to 10 users.
heading: Secure Authentication

text: When a user issues a critical DNP3 request that is one which requires authentication, and it is successfully authenticated, the PowerLogic ADVC Controller will write two events to the Event Log. One event shows the type of request and the other shows the ID of the requesting user.
heading: Secure Authentication

text: As per the DNP3 Standard (IEEE 1815-2012), the PowerLogic ADVC Controller maintains a number of statistics associated with DNP3 Secure Authentication. These statistics are displayed by WSOS on the DNP3 Security Statistics page.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: Display> Switchgear Communications > Protocols >DNP3 > DNP3 Security Statistics
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: DNP Security Statistics values and settings
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: NOTE: Statistics can also be read using DNP3 Read requests, for objects in group 121. The map for statistics points is fixed, as per table 7-6 of IEEE 1815-2012.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: Each statistic recorded has an associated event threshold, configurable on the DNP3 Security Statistics page.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: Each time a threshold is reached, the PowerLogic ADVC Controller will generate a DNP3 event. Note that for events to be generated, the corresponding statistic point must be assigned a non-zero DNP3 class.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: When a DNP3 map is written to the PowerLogic ADVC Controller, the class of all security statistics points is automatically reset to zero.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: To assign a non-zero class to any point, a DNP3 Assign Class request must be issued for that point.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: Classes assigned in this way will persist until the next time a DNP3 map is written to the PowerLogic ADVC Controller.
heading: DNP3 Security Statistics

text: Some statistics have associated, configurable maximum values. The meaning of and behavior corresponding to these maximum values is defined in the DNP3 Standard IEEE 1815-2012.
